0022600207.text: The Indiana Pacers (3-7, 0-5 at home, 3-2 on the road) are on a one-game losing streak as they visit the Dallas Mavericks (5-4, 3-2 at home), who enter on a one-game winning streak, for the Pacers' 11th game of the 2026-27 season. Indiana sits 11th in the East and 3rd in the Central, 4 games back, while Dallas is 10th in the West and 4th in the Southwest, 2 games back. The Pacers are without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), and the Mavericks are without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). Indiana trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 121-105 loss in Indianapolis on October 23, and it also lost both meetings in the 2025-26 season.
